scenario.note: A rule that enforces short-time workers in year 2 to be at least 3 times those in year 1.
The rule ensures that the total number of workers on short-time working in year 2 is at least three times that of year 1.
A rule that limits the ratio of redundant workers in year 1 to those in year 2.
A relative limit on the sum of redundant workers for year 1 compared to year 2.
A rule limits the proportion of short-time workers at the semi-skilled level relative to all short-time workers.
The share of semi_skilled workers on short-time working relative to all short-time workers is capped at 5%.
